versions.changelog: v2.3.0: Remove blocking modal — compaction is now fully background with toast-only status. v2.2.0: Full background isolation — filter memory flush messages and COMPACTION divider from chat timeline. parentId skip-set constrained to message-only entries to prevent cascade.

No file changes detected for this release.

- No updates or code changes were made in version 2.1.1.
- Functionality and features remain the same as version 2.1.0.
v2.1.0: Conversation summary paragraph, model selector, settings reload fix

- Introduces a manual memory compaction button to the OpenClaw Control UI with a circular context gauge showing token usage.
- Gauge color-codes usage (Green/Yellow/Red) and displays token statistics; compaction triggers a modal with animated progress steps.
- Compaction now uses LLM-based summarization, replacing basic line trimming, and reports token count before/after compaction.
- Chat history UI now shows labeled divider lines for compaction events and filters out NO_REPLY/HEARTBEAT_OK messages.
- Requires patching three OpenClaw source files and rebuild/restart after install.
